notes: Accessed via direct HTTP fetch (curl); robots.txt (www.nkuku.com/robots.txt) has no Claude-specific disallow, only standard bot rules. Shopify store; enumerated the FULL collections catalogue via /collections.json (4 pages, limit=250, 781 total collections) and grepped for christmas/halloween/diwali/easter/valentine/thanksgiving/new-year/holi/rakhi/eid/festive/festival/holiday/seasonal/wreath/bauble/advent/stocking/ornament keywords, then cross-checked against the real mobile mega-menu markup in the homepage HTML (the 'Christmas' nav node, 3 sub-groups: Christmas Decorations / Festive Home / Christmas Themes / Inspiration). Also checked the pages sitemap (sitemap_pages_1.xml) for standalone holiday landing pages (only /pages/christmas, /pages/christmas-shop, /pages/easter-weekend [a shipping-hours notice, not a category], /pages/new-season -- none are PLPs). Only Christmas is present as a genuine seasonal category; no Halloween, Diwali, Valentine's, Thanksgiving, New Year, or other Indian/regional festival categories exist anywhere in the taxonomy. Qty = the site's own rendered 'N items' collection count (matches priority-1 displayed-total method), confirmed non-constant across pages (5-186), so not a site-wide cap. 'All Christmas Decorations' (/collections/all-christmas), 'All Festive Decorations' (/collections/festive-decorations) and 'All Christmas Collections' (/collections/all-christmas-collections) are the genuine umbrella/parent pages for their respective menu sections (each has a materially larger or overlapping count than the sum of its listed children), so each is recorded as a grouping row (qty/link null) per Rule 9, immediately followed by its children. Excluded as non-seasonal-category / marketing / duplicate-of-general-catalogue, all confirmed by fetching each page and reading its own og:title/og:description: 'New Christmas' (/collections/new-christmas, new-arrivals style curated 'new' page, excluded per core NEVER-EXTRACT 'New Arrivals'); 'Christmas Signatures' (/collections/signatures-collection, under the menu's 'Inspiration' group, described as 'the pieces our customers return to year after year' i.e. a Christmas best-sellers/curated page, excluded per core NEVER-EXTRACT 'Best Sellers' and seasonal-rules SS4 'Christmas Inspiration' example); 'Candles & Candleholders' (/collections/all-candles-candleholders, 128 items) is literally the site's general, year-round Candles & Candle Holders collection reused under the Christmas menu -- its own description has no Christmas/festive language at all, so per SS5/SS6 (seasonal product type != seasonal category) it is not recorded as a Seasonal row even though it is nav-linked from the Christmas menu; 'Christmas Sale' / '30% Off Christmas Gifts & Decorations' / 'Bank Holiday Offers' and the '*-archived' Christmas collections (classic-christmas-archived, opulent-christmas-archived, all-christmas-gifts-archived) are Sale/Offers/Archived pages, excluded per core rules; 'Easter Offers' (/collections/easter-offers) fetched directly: og:description is '15% off handcrafted furniture, unique home accessories, tableware, serveware, and planters and vases' with 0 items currently -- a generic seasonal discount campaign, not an Easter product category, so it is not recorded and NO_SEASONAL applies to Easter specifically. Numerous per-product-line collections with 'Christmas' in the title (Danvi Christmas Collection, Tanu Christmas Collection, Roshani Christmas Collection, Amata Christmas Decorations, Christmas Karru Collection, Imay Nutcracker Collection, Madhi Wreath Collection, and the many individual bauble-set collections such as Gold/Green/Multicolour/Clear Baubles, Ratnam/Nishan/Oko/Jalshara/Manipur/Sardi/Tanu/Patta baubles) exist in the raw Shopify catalogue but are not linked anywhere in the real site navigation -- they are single product-family/SKU pages (brand-name style), not genuine navigational sub-categories, so per core rules ('brand-name/designer listing pages are not categories') they are excluded.
